steps.say: CD19 CAR-T therapy is resetting immunity in refractory lupus, myositis, and scleroderma. Tissue-resident with circulating autoreactive B cells and plasma precursors are deleted comprehensively. Drug-free sustained remission is following the reset. Deep B-cell depletion is emptying niches that antibodies never reach. Engineered T cells are resetting autoimmunity.

Refractory severe lupus, myositis, systemic sclerosis

steps.say: Anifrolumab is blocking all type 1 interferons at their shared receptor. Fully human IgG1 kappa antibody against IFNAR1 subunit 1 is jamming the gate. STAT1 with STAT2 phosphorylation from alpha, beta, and omega interferons is halted. Moderate-to-severe lupus with skin and joint disease is yielding to it. Receptor blockade is silencing all type 1 interferons.

vis.alt: Type I interferonopathy pathway with cytosolic nucleic acids driving STING, JAK-STAT signaling, interferon overproduction, basal ganglia calcification, and chilblain lesions.
vis.caption: Type I interferon pathway that anifrolumab blocks at IFNAR1. Trial outcomes are in the text, not on the drawing (StewardMD).

steps.say: Avacopan is replacing steroids in ANCA vasculitis by mouth. Oral selective blockade of the C5a receptor CD88 is starving complement inflammation. Phase 3 ADVOCATE success with rising kidney filtration is proving the swap. Steroid toxicities are melting away with the taper. Complement blockade is sparing steroids and kidneys.

Complement blockade is sparing steroids and kidneys.

rows: Oral small-molecule C5a receptor CD88 antagonist
Improving eGFR with fewer steroid toxicities

steps.say: Obinutuzumab is outkilling rituximab in proliferative lupus nephritis. Type 2 glycoengineered anti-CD20 design is dealing direct non-apoptotic death. Stronger antibody cellular cytotoxicity is clearing more B cells. Phase 2 NOBILITY complete renal responses are proving the upgrade. Engineered CD20 killing is beating older clones.

vis.alt: Proliferative lupus nephritis biopsy with endocapillary and mesangial proliferation, wire loop lesions, and immune complex deposits.

steps.say: Deucravacitinib is jamming TYK2 through its pseudokinase pocket. Oral first-in-class allosteric binding at the JH2 regulatory domain is freezing receptor shape. Interleukin 23 with interleukin 12 and type 1 interferon signaling is silenced together. JAK1 with JAK2 and JAK3 is spared entirely. Pseudokinase gripping is silencing three cytokines.

steps.say: Dapirolizumab pegol is blocking T-B costimulation without clot risk. Pegylated Fab fragment against CD40 ligand CD154 is cutting the handshake. Missing Fc domain is dodging platelet activation and thromboembolism. Lupus is yielding without the clots that sank older drugs. Cut costimulation is sparing clots.

steps.say: BTK blockade is calming hyperactive receptor cascades in ongoing studies. Fenebrutinib alongside remibrutinib is interrupting downstream BCR plus Fc-receptor traffic. Lymphoid with myeloid compartments are settled together. Pivotal programs in lupus, Sjogren illness, and lasting hives are progressing. Kinase quieting is helping three illnesses.
